{1000}{28c
Offer to him
Who cannot see
Nor hear
Your soul, made of trees.}
{1001}{28c

To touch, to burn
For his eyes are dark
And his ears are blunt
And wasted.
}
{1002}{28c
Wisdom comes
To the bringer of gifts
And eyes that see far
From he

Unless you dream the cold-blood dream
Call only to the Snake Fathers
When you hear their voices of old.
}

Makaal seeks Heartstone
He runs with you, he hunts with you
Give Makaal his Heartstone
And swift as Makaal you will be.
}

Do you know of Dwarven Stone?
Is anything so true?
Not words nor ways of magick
Not sun, nor trees, nor sky of blue.
}
{1021}{28c
Oh Alberich, great god of Stone
The world lays on your spine
We who live within your heart
Seek now to know your mind.
}
{1022}{28c
We bring to you the pitted rocks
That once burned in your veins
And now we ask for Stone and strength
Until the end of days.
}

{1030}{28c
Geshtianna, we pray
That you show us your Love
Your face, like the newest  moon
Your spirit, as the whitest of doves.
}
{1031}{28c
We bring you this gift
The root with your name
For often it is that Love
And Passion are the same.
}
{1032}{28c
So bless us now, Oh goddess
With your beauty and your might
So that others might see in us
Your pure and precious light.
}

{1040}{28c
Halcyon, great god of truth
Master of the sky
Reveal yourself now to us
Pull the veil from our eyes.
}
{1041}{28c
You father, the light
Your mother, the sun
And you, the path of truth
You, the only one.
}
{1042}{28c
With this branch of olive
Your endless wisdom I seek
Grant me now your power
Your sight, both long and deep.
}

Great Torg, mighty Torg
You know our bone and blood
Great Torg, mighty Torg
Your fury like a flood.
}
{1051}{28c
Old Torg, Wise Torg
Your children lost their way
Old Torg, Wise Torg
Their hearts, the price is paid.
}
{1052}{28c
Great Torg, mighty Torg
I bring you rubies of red
Old Torg, Wise Torg
My heart is yours, until I’m dead.
}

{1060}{28c
Bolo, clever thief
Progo, watchful eye
Shadow, now here now gone
Arm, now here now gone
}
{1061}{28c
Bolo, face of pain
Progo, face of rage
Soul, now here now gone
Progo, now here now gone
}
{1062}{28c
Bolo, god of thieves
One-armed god of thieves

Your blessing, now here now here

{1070}{28c
Kerlin, heart of gold
Who sung the world to be
You, great god of all things gold
We turn our eyes to thee.
}
{1071}{28c
Within the earth flow rivers
Of your precious words and songs
And now from these we make our coin
For what from you is wrong?
}
{1072}{28c
And now we give this coin to you
Let this small Mnura be
A reminder of you, Golden God
Help me know its worth and see.
}

{1080}{28c
Great Horned God
Terrible, powerful, Great Horned God
We shake before you, tremble before you
Great Horned God of Pain.
}
{1081}{28c
Fearsome Great Shakar
Angry, wrathful, Great Shakar
Handle of bone, blade of steel
Shakar Great God of Rage.

{1082}{28c
The Great Ram, Shakar
Fierce, awesome, mighty Shakar
Give me your blessing, your war-like ways
The Furious Ram, Shakar.

{1090}{28c
Flows like a shadow
Over the ground
Dark eyes waiting, watching
Dark hands waiting, watching.
}
{1091}{28c
Aged, ancient Moorindal
God of the falling night
Shadows spill like blackest ink
Over all that’s new and bright.
}
{1092}{28c
Beautiful black diamond
Like your soul both dark and deep
Dark eyes waiting, watching
Dark hands waiting, watching.
}

{1100}{28c
She weighs your worth
Within her hands
Great goddess of the scale
She holds you
She sees you
She knows your every tale.
}
{1101}{28c
Kai’tan, I bow
And bring to you
This stone with heart of jewels
Weigh it now
Hold it now
Maiden, fair and cruel.
}

{1110}{28c
All gods have a father
And he watches over them
His children call
His children, all
He holds them all as gems.

{1111}{28c
But Velorien is hard and old
And his ways are set in stone
He has all
And expects all
With your life you will atone.

If his children you don’t know

{1200}{28l
 What are Rune stones? Nobody knows.
They have been called Rune stones for centuries now, made by forgotten mages of the past. No one knows their true function, or their true purpose. Many legends surround them, and even more speculation. In one city, a magic shop is built next to one, and the proprietor claims that it gives his products more power. In a rural village, one is said to cure infertility, although they look rather uncomfortable for that activity.
Deep in a dungeon, there was once a cursed book that described their manufacture, placement and  use. They seem to be marriage of magic and technology seemingly impossible today, made of unknown materials and infused with powerful spells.  In order to activate them you need first to touch one of the Binding Stones. The Runestone is the place of your departure. The Binding Stone is the place of your destination. Two known Binding Stones exist. One more Binding stone is rumored to exist. One in a place of true light.
By the  master of literature  Shadygrove and his student Chris
}    

{1210}{28l
There is one Binding Stone in Caladon and one Binding Stone in Tarant. Therefore, from any known Shrine of the Gods you can travel either to Tarant or Caladon. 
Travel requires you to have first touched and activated either the Caladon or Tarant Binding Stone and each person can only have one binding stone activated at a time, that being the last one he has touched. Also in order for the Binding Stone to accept you need to carry a sacrificial item: A ruby for the Tarant Binding Stone and a kathorn crystal for the Caladon Binding Stone. 
When you touch any rune word of power the sacrificial item will disappear and you will be transported instantly to the last Binding Stone that you have touched.
It is also rumored that one Binding Stone exists in the legendary capital of the Elves Qintarra. But it is unknown what is required for its operation .
}

They speak of a dark place full of misery and dark mystic energies but anyone who dares to say more about this place suddenly dies from a curious curse.
Such a Binding Stone if it ever existed would be imbued in great evilness and could only be operated by evil persons.
